reason: Two phase-offset periodic sources can produce high CV and CV2; V1 would misclassify their combined train.
scope: Apply identically to all 62 runs, every observed group and all three detection thresholds.
test: 199 ISI permutations; spectrum standardized per frequency symmetrically over the observed+surrogate ensemble; max standardized excess over 0.5-15Hz and at least 8 cycles per window; plus-one p; same full search in every surrogate.
decision: V1 irregular with p<=.05 becomes patterned_bursts. V1 irregular with p>.05 retains descriptive irregular_bursts; non-rejection is not proof of aperiodicity.
